- **v2 vs v1: {{cmp.v2.summary.verdict}}** ({{cmp.v2.summary.n_improved}} improved, {{cmp.v2.summary.n_neutral}} neutral, {{cmp.v2.summary.n_inconclusive}} inconclusive, {{cmp.v2.summary.n_regressed}} regressed). `retrieval_recall_at_3` rose from {{cmp.v2.retrieval_recall_at_3.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.v2.retrieval_recall_at_3.candidate|.4f}} and `retrieval_mrr_at_3` from {{cmp.v2.retrieval_mrr_at_3.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.v2.retrieval_mrr_at_3.candidate|.4f}}, both significant in the paired bootstrap. `success_rate` rose from {{cmp.v2.success_rate.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.v2.success_rate.candidate|.4f}} and `abstention_correct` from {{cmp.v2.abstention_correct.baseline|.1f}} to {{cmp.v2.abstention_correct.candidate|.1f}}, but neither change is significant (McNemar p = {{cmp.v2.success_rate.p_value|.1g}} and {{cmp.v2.abstention_correct.p_value|.1g}}), so both are inconclusive rather than improvements.
- **v3 vs v1: {{cmp.v3.summary.verdict}}** ({{cmp.v3.summary.n_regressed}} regressed, {{cmp.v3.summary.n_improved}} improved, {{cmp.v3.summary.n_neutral}} neutral, {{cmp.v3.summary.n_inconclusive}} inconclusive). `groundedness` fell from {{cmp.v3.groundedness.baseline|.1f}} to {{cmp.v3.groundedness.candidate|.1f}} on all {{cmp.v3.groundedness.n_pairs}} answerable cases and `gold_citation_recall` from {{cmp.v3.gold_citation_recall.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.v3.gold_citation_recall.candidate|.1f}} because the fluent style drops every citation, `citation_precision` disappeared because nothing is cited, and `success_rate` fell from {{cmp.v3.success_rate.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.v3.success_rate.candidate|.4f}}. Retrieval improved exactly as in v2 and mean heuristic tokens dropped ({{cmp.v3.total_tokens.baseline|.2f}} to {{cmp.v3.total_tokens.candidate|.2f}}). Failure-count deltas: `ungrounded` {{cmp.v3.fail.ungrounded|signed}}, `retrieval_miss` {{cmp.v3.fail.retrieval_miss|signed}}, `incomplete_answer` {{cmp.v3.fail.incomplete_answer|signed}}, `missed_abstention` {{cmp.v3.fail.missed_abstention|signed}}. The report surfaces the trade-off instead of a single pass/fail number.
